_about: Knowledge bites extracted from two imported documents for insight/ideation. Authored as the LLM (no API). red-dots is the operator's own Hebrew essay (translated faithfully to English); dan-koe-1day is Dan Koe's essay. Load with: python scripts/seed_profile.py --file data/imports_seed.json

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: A small red dot or sticker beside an artwork in a gallery marks that the piece has been sold.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Making art is the individual's passion — a years-long process of learning, immersion and sacrifice that does not rise to depth over time without devotion and giving things up.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Pesach Slavosky likened artists who keep creating for years to sea turtles: masses of hatchlings head for the sea, but only a few reach maturity and the deep open water.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Once revealed, art is a gift to society with a distinct social-cultural role: poets give us words, musicians the soundtrack of our lives; visual art lets its language make existence more complex and meaningful — it becomes our cultural DNA.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: All these creative processes require energy; because art is a matter of spirit the economic component is under-discussed, but economy is energy — another way the spirit takes form.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: In Israel 2026 society treats art as far below secondary — overshadowed by war, fear and death, politics and survival, hi-tech and weapons development, and entertainment.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Investment in visual/plastic art is almost nil: state budgets approach zero, collectors are very few, and press coverage and criticism are minimal.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Most of the artist's Bezalel-era peers who once mounted significant exhibitions have disappeared; galleries are closing and the culture is shrinking, a circle of too-little feeding itself.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Buying art, beyond the joy of living with a piece, is pure energy: energy for making, for renewal, and for a meaningful presence of art in the culture.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: People spend on expensive restaurants and travel, but buying art rarely even crosses their minds; it is simply not on the agenda — yet if the thought arose, many likely would buy.

bites.source_title: Red Dots (essay)
bites.author: the operator
bites.text: Culture is us — makers and viewers alike; like life itself, if we do not make it, it simply will not exist, or will be too impoverished. Buy art.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: You aren't where you want to be because you aren't yet the person who would be there; change who you are (first-order) so behavior follows naturally, rather than forcing actions (second-order).

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: If you want a specific outcome in life, you must adopt the lifestyle that creates that outcome long before you reach it.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: All behavior is goal-oriented (teleological), but the goals are usually unconscious — e.g. procrastination can serve the goal of protecting yourself from the judgment of finishing and sharing your work.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: A goal is a projection into the future that acts as a lens of perception, letting you notice the information, ideas and resources that aid in achieving it.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: The anatomy of identity: you want a goal, perceive reality through its lens, notice only goal-relevant info, act and get feedback, repeat until automatic (conditioning), it becomes 'I am the type of person who…', you defend it, and it shapes new goals.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: When identity is threatened you enter fight-or-flight just as with a bodily threat; this is why people get stuck in echo chambers and double down on beliefs that harm them.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: The mind evolves through ~9 stages of ego development (Impulsive, Self-Protective, Conformist, Self-Aware, Conscientious, Individualist, Strategist, Construct-Aware, Unitive); most people hover between Self-Aware (4) and Construct-Aware (8).

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: Intelligence is the art of steering (cybernetics, 'kybernetikos'): have a goal, act toward it, sense where you are, compare to the goal, and act again on the feedback — iterating and persisting.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: Identity flips follow Dissonance → Uncertainty → Discovery; the one-day protocol builds an 'anti-vision' (the life you refuse) to convert negative energy into intrinsic motivation toward a 'vision MVP'.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: Turn life into a video game: vision = how you win, anti-vision = what's at stake, the 1-year goal = the mission, the 1-month project = the boss fight, daily levers = quests, constraints = the rules.

bites.source_title: How to fix your entire life in 1 day
bites.author: Dan Koe
bites.text: Csikszentmihalyi: optimal experience and order in consciousness arise when psychic energy — attention — is invested in realistic goals matched to one's skills.
